name: BCL2 like 12
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: BCL2L12 encodes bcl-2-like protein 12. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: BCL2L12 encodes a BH2-domain-containing regulator of apoptosis. In the cytoplasm it inhibits caspases 3 and 7; in the nucleus it can bind p53 and prevent p53 from associating with target genes. These distinct cellular locations connect inhibition of apoptotic proteases with modulation of a transcriptional stress response.
